_form: IT-182 - Passive Activity Loss Limitations for Nonresidents and Part-Year Residents
_notes: Submit with IT-203 or IT-205. Parts IV-IX use 'worksheet N' field naming. Some field names are misleading in Part VIII — see notes below.

fields.name: Name as shown on return
fields.identifying number: Identifying number as shown on return (SSN)
fields.1a dollars: Line 1a - Rental real estate: net income from Part IV, column (a)
fields.1b dollars: Line 1b - Rental real estate: net loss from Part IV, column (b)
fields.1c dollars: Line 1c - Rental real estate: prior years unallowed losses from Part IV, column (c)
fields.2a dollars: Line 2a - Other passive: net income from Part V, column (a)
fields.2b dollars: Line 2b - Other passive: net loss from Part V, column (b)
fields.2c dollars: Line 2c - Other passive: prior years unallowed losses from Part V, column (c)
fields.3 dollars: Line 3 - Add lines 1d and 2d and subtract any prior year unallowed CRD
fields._Part II: Special allowance for rental real estate (positive amounts only)
fields.4 dollars: Line 4 - Smaller of loss on line 1d or loss on line 3
fields.6 dollars: Line 6 - Federal modified AGI (not less than zero)
fields.9 dollars: Line 9 - Smaller of line 4 or line 8
fields.10 dollars: Line 10 - Add income from lines 1a and 2a
fields.11 dollars: Line 11 - Total losses allowed from all passive activities (add lines 9 and 10)
